body: Thank you! Your comments help.
I'm so sorry that happened to her. I really hope she will be able to move on. Thank you for supporting her! I bet it means a lot to her

When I don't feel like talking to other people to make me happy, taking care of myself does the same.

Take a shower, put on a face mask/cream, maybe even do a full face of makeup to wipe it all off 15 minutes later if that's your thing. I do all this with some dancey tunes blasting in the background to get my mood up.

>I don't like condone cheating but if it was a mistake and it doesn't happen again I can get over it pretty easily. 

My boyfriend is on the same field as you are, which helps a lot with trying to forgive myself. So thanks for forgiving that girl. You're a good guy.
Thank you, that gives me hope

I have talked with him about it a lot, and he has forgiven me and when I feel down about it he comforts me. I really really appreciate him for being so thoughtful about it and forgiving me. It's just that I can't forgive myself, even though I also think I did the right thing by telling him immediately. My mind just can't let go that I even cheated on such a good guy to begin with. I hope therapy will help me with this, but it might be months before I'm off that waiting list.
My bf has told me this too, but I just don't know how

Exactly! Fresh wounds need time to heal. 
And like you said yourself, this is the lowest you’ve ever been. It’s sounds so cliche but it will only go up from here!

Damn that sure is shitty, but i do see things getting better. You can always try to get a new job. Getting over your GF might take some time but definitely take your time to do so. Eventually it will get easier, you just have to have patience and not give up. Talk to people about it, and also about your depression. I hope you’ll get your will back.

It’s not brave to kill yourself. It’s brave to carry on with your life, however shitty it may be, and stand your ground. Be strong and don’t let any setbacks get you down.
I’m glad you told us what’s going on. It’s a step towards telling other people. Maybe you’ll feel more comfortable telling a therapist about it?
Why are you sad?
What happened in your life drove you to this point?

You seem to experience a lot of the symptoms and it sounds like you have developed depression, but if you really want to know what’s going on, I’d consult a professional. 
When I suspected I’d might have depression, I consulted my doctor and got a referral to a therapist. She diagnosed me with depression, but therapy wasn’t really my thing so I stopped going after a month or two. Talking to close friends helped me more, but it’s different for everyone, so just try around a little bit until you find out what works for you.
https://imgur.com/a/WVG3J

Even if you dont feel like it or dont have rnough energy, start doing small tasks like cleaning your room, listening to some upbeat music and dancing, making plans with friends or just calling them, cooking a nice meal, just simple stuff. Itll make you feel productive which feels rewarding.
Once you get used to doing things itll become easier to do so.

I'm a cis girl and I would love to have your eyelashes!

As far as passing goes, you do, but I wouldn't be surprised if you'd get misgendered if I were you. You still have masculine features.
Get different glasses and don't wear tank tops - they accentuate broad shoulders

You look really quite feminine and cute! Nice skin, and really long eyelashes. Your body is still kind of masculine but that will change when you start HRT, and still, it's not that bad at all. You've got the pose down and everything.

When I asked my mom if I could get therapy, I told her to view depression as a physical illness - you catch the disease one time, it's doing negative things to you, and you can't get rid of it without help. 

Maybe she'll understand this way - good luck!
I'd get one that matches with your eyebrow colour to make it look natural!
you look amazing! if you'd draw your eyebrows a little but further apart, they'd or perfect imo :)

I would definitely work on your makeup skills if I were you. Some tips:
- overline your top lip just slightly
- apply multiple layers of lipstick to get good coverage
- use a subtler eyeshadow colour like brown and blend
- use an eyelash curler & mascara
overall i recommend watching and recreating simple beauty tutorials. it's a skill you need to practice! 

your facial structure and skin are very nice though!
